decision: Resolve F01-SG002 prospectively. The repository-root schemas/** and openapi/** trees are the sole canonical source authority; src/epistemic_foundry/_canonical/** is a deterministic derived package snapshot owned by B04. Authorize the next unused B04 correction attempt to restore and receipt projection freshness, followed only after B04 PASS by F01-0003 revalidation. Preserve the package-level DAG without a static F01-B04 cycle, preserve F01-0002 and all prior B04 and RAH history, keep F02 and F03 waiting on F01 PASS, prohibit reverse synchronization and stale fallbacks, and keep completion_ready false.
rationale: F01-0002 correctly found that its verified root canonical schema change made the B04-owned derived snapshot stale. This decision fixes source authority, projection ownership, attempt-level correction sequencing, receipt and freshness gates, and the separation of the pre-existing S04-TM004 debt without granting F01 snapshot ownership, creating a static dependency cycle, weakening schemas, modifying prior evidence, or permitting Fleet or subagents.
